anti_overlap: fd-personality-prior-art-gaps covers game design precedent; this covers real-world personality science
decision_lens: Predictive validity — personality dimensions must actually predict behavior differences, not just describe preferences
distance_rationale: I/O psych solves the exact same problem (which personality dimensions predict behavior?) but with empirical validation, not game design intuition.
expected_isomorphisms: Factor analysis for axis independence, person-environment fit for role satisfaction, and complementarity research for relationship dynamics.
focus: Organizational psychology's lessons on personality assessment, team composition, and trait interaction
name: fd-hr-psychometrics-selection
persona: Industrial-organizational psychologist who designs personality assessments for team composition and predicts group performance from trait profiles
review_areas: Evaluate the Big Five vs proposed 3-axis model: Big Five research shows which personality dimensions predict work behavior (Conscientiousness and Agreeableness strongest) — do the proposed axes map to these?
Check whether axes predict different DOMAINS of behavior: introversion→social, patience→task completion, pride→status-seeking — or do they overlap?
Assess 'person-environment fit' — I/O psych shows personality effects depend on context. Does a proud elf suffer more in a low-prestige role than a humble one?
Evaluate 'complementarity vs similarity' in team composition: research shows some traits work best when mixed (complementary) while others work best when matched (similar)
Check for the 'dark triad' problem: extremely high pride + low patience + high extroversion = toxic personality that should create specific negative dynamics, not just low numbers

severity_examples.condition: Axis name/description implies one behavioral domain but implementation affects another
severity_examples.scenario: Patience axis maps to Conscientiousness but the brainstorm frames it as impulse control — these predict different behaviors (work quality vs social disruption)
No person-environment fit effect: a proud elf assigned to gathering (low-prestige role) should suffer more than a humble elf, but the system treats role satisfaction as personality-independent

success_hints: Each axis predicts a distinct behavioral domain. Personality interacts with context (roles, relationships, events) to produce situational effects, not just flat modifiers.
task_context: The proposed axes need to produce meaningful behavioral differences in a simulation. I/O psychology has decades of data on which personality dimensions actually predict behavior.
